objective: Prevent population prevalence claims from a small convenience sample.
scenario: Five convenience-sampled interviews describe a recurring workaround; the draft claims 80 percent of all students experience it.
expected_behaviors: Remove or qualify the prevalence estimate.
Report the pattern as exploratory within the interviewed participants.
Suggest an appropriate sampling or quantitative study if prevalence is decision-critical.
prohibited_behaviors: Treat the convenience sample as representative.
Calculate population percentages from qualitative notes.
